question: Which committee was appointed by the Government of India “to operationalise the suggestions to teach Fundamental Duties to the citizens of India” ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice JS Verma Committee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• J S Verma Committee:-

 
 
• The committee to 'Operationalise the Suggestions to Teach Fundamental Duties to the Citizens of the Country' was J S Verma Committee.
 
• It was chaired by Justice J.S. Verma and was appointed by the Atal Bihari Vajpayee government in 1998.
 
• The committee made a number of recommendations on how to teach fundamental duties to citizens of all ages, including through school curricula, public awareness campaigns, and government programs.
 
• The J.S. Verma Committee's report also made a number of recommendations on other issues, such as reforming the police and the criminal justice system, and addressing the root causes of violence against women.
 
• These recommendations have not been fully implemented, but they continue to be relevant and important.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Justice BN Srikrishna Committee** 

 
 
• A committee headed by retired Supreme Court Judge Justice BN Srikrishna submitted its report on "Data Protection Framework". 
 
• Committee proposed a draft Personal Data Protection Bill that could form the basis of India’s first data privacy law. 
 
• The proposed bill makes individual consent the centrepiece of data sharing, awards rights to users & imposes obligations on “data fiduciaries”.
